title: Find what went well
objective: I can show one thing that went well and a real clue.
success_criteria: I can find my real work or note.
I can show one part that went well.
I can link my idea to a real clue.

scheme_row.outcome_paraphrased: Look back at the shared piece and identify a strength supported by actual work.

lesson_sequence: Lesson 1 links a strength to an actual observation through the shared checkpoint. Lesson 2 recalls that record, completes the review, selects a checkable next step and shares or refines it.
layout_reference: Week 8 layout; accepted Week 4 paired edition
award_status: Practice evidence only. No completion decision, encounter, public event or completed response is pre-filled.
picture_colours: Picture colours. Navy is used for symbols, lines and numbers. White is the page and the eye space. Amber, cream, mint green and pale blue are cue box fills. Grey and silver are used in the mark. Black is used for the mark corners. Words, numbers and shapes give the meaning. Green · Ready, Amber · Help, Red · Pause.
marking_formula: in the same colour, on the same page or usual mode
